description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Financial Statements for year ended 31st December 2022
categorisation: This gazette content contains an independent auditor's report on the financial statements of The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9) as it is not about land, legal/regulatory matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement. This is an administrative matter related to a professional institute's financial reporting, making it Miscellaneous.
